title: serving-runtime daily scratchpad 2026-04-03
content:
2026-04-03 -- scratchpad

Morning goals:
- triage KV cache leak (INF-482). repro on staging (seq_len=1024, concurrency 8).
  - observed mem growth on worker-03 after ~12k requests.
  - hypothesis: stale shard entries not evicted when model variant rotates.
  - quick repro steps: run `python tools/loadtest.py --model redwood-mini --seq 1024 --concurrency 8 --duration 30m` on staging + monitor `nvtop` + `/metrics` endpoint.
  - next: add logging around cache eviction path and run with debug build.

- follow up on kernel selection perf regression (INF-491).
  - regression surfaced after 2026-03-30 kernel tweak (PR 1287).
  - summary: H100 throughput for long-context (2k tokens) dropped ~18% vs baseline. A100 not as affected.
  - collect perf artifacts: perf traces (flamegraph), NVPROF sample, and kernel invocation counts.
  - try rolling back kernel selector to previous heuristics and run A/B perf on canary.

Notes / findings:
- KV cache leak: local quick patch idea is to force a sync evict pass when variant changes. Might be band-aid; root cause seems to be missing reference decrement in variant switch path.
- Kernel selection: selector picks tensor-core path aggressively for floats even when sequence length favors streaming kernels. Need to add sequence-length breakpoint for kernel choice.

To-do (prioritized):
1) INF-482: add eviction logging + minimal repro harness on staging. Target: reproduce reliably by EOD. (owner: Noah)
2) INF-491: create perf run matrix (A100/H100) with seq {512,1024,2048} and batch {1,4,8}. Upload results to PR 1287. (owner: Ethan)
3) Add unit test for variant-switch refcount behavior in cache module. (owner: Maya)
4) Quick rollback plan for kernel selector if canary shows >10% regression in p99 latency. (owner: Noah + SRE)
5) Perf experiment: try disabling tensor-core kernel for seq>=1536 and measure. (owner: Noah)

Meeting notes:
- 11:00 sync with SRE: discussed staging noise — SRE suggests isolating a single worker host for reproducible runs. agreed to pin runs to worker-03.
- 15:30 weekly runtime grooming: backlog prioritized; pushing INF-482 + INF-491 to top of sprint.

Commands / quick snippets:
- repro loadtest: `python tools/loadtest.py --model redwood-mini --seq 1024 --concurrency 8 --duration 30m --target worker-03`
- collect metrics: `curl -s http://worker-03:9090/metrics | grep redis_kv_cache`
- run perf: `./scripts/run_perf.sh --device h100 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --out perf-2026-04-03/`

Open questions / risks:
- If eviction patch increases latency on hot paths, need to consider background eviction thread vs inline eviction.
- Kernel selector heuristics interact with quantized kernels differently; turning off tensor-core path might hurt quantized runs.

Quick wins / low effort items:
- add debug flag `KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1` to staging env to enable extra counters for a 24h run.
- add simple health endpoint that reports cache size per-variant to make triage faster.

Notes to self:
- push minimal logging change to staging branch `noah/kv-evict-logging` and link to INF-482.
- remind QA to prioritize long-context smoke tests after fix merged.

End of day checklist:
- [ ] repro INF-482 on staging
- [ ] upload perf traces for INF-491
- [ ] create rollback playbook for kernel selector
- [ ] open follow-up Jira for unit test coverage
summary: Daily serving-runtime notes: triage KV cache leak (INF-482), investigate kernel selection perf regression (INF-491/PR 1287), perf runs on A100/H100, to-dos assigned and commands for repro.
